proposals.old: Run the reproduction and relevant surrounding tests to show the fix holds.
proposals.new: Run the reproduction and relevant surrounding checks on the final artifact. Then inspect the final changes for unintended behavior, compatibility or preservation problems, and unrelated edits. Use an available diff or compare the relevant before-and-after content; version-control tooling is not required. Record the results and any unreviewed areas before completing this step.

observed_failure.rationale: The worker demonstrated meaningful pre-fix failures and post-fix success, but no substantive final artifact or scope review followed. Test success alone did not establish that review.

proposals.predicted_benefit: Preserves the existing reproduction-first approach while adding an explicit, tool-independent final review before verification closure.
proposals.risks: Adds a review obligation to small fixes; keep its depth proportional to the changed surface rather than requiring another broad test run or a separate review artifact.
proposals.transfer_example: For a configuration-loader defect, rerun the failing configuration case and adjacent compatibility checks, then compare the changed parsing logic and protected configuration content.

proposals.old: Improve clarity or structure only while keeping the new verification green.
proposals.new: Review the implemented slice against the acceptance criteria and existing invariants, including scope, compatibility, and preservation. Use an available diff or a before-and-after content comparison. If refinement is warranted, keep it small and rerun the affected verification after changes. If no refinement is warranted, state why; do not change working code merely to satisfy this step. Record the review and verification results before completing it.

observed_failure.rationale: The feature worker ran meaningful RED before implementation and obtained GREEN afterward, but the attempted Git check failed and no substantive review fallback or justified no-op refinement was recorded before the refinement step was checked.

proposals.predicted_benefit: Makes refinement an evidence-backed decision rather than an automatic checkmark, supports a justified no-op, and provides a review path when Git is unavailable.
proposals.risks: May overlap with later validation. Reuse the same review evidence and passing results when the artifact has not changed; avoid gratuitous restructuring or duplicate execution.
proposals.transfer_example: For a new export option, compare the implementation with the agreed behavior and existing output guarantees, retain a simple implementation when appropriate, and rerun relevant checks only if refinement changes it.

proposals.old: Summarize what changed, checks run, and any follow-up risks or skipped validation.
proposals.new: Before marking this step complete, provide the handoff: summarize what changed, identify the checks actually performed and their results, and disclose remaining risks or skipped validation. Distinguish completed work from recommended next actions. If this summary has already been provided, reference it rather than repeat it.

observed_failure.rationale: The worker checked the handoff step before delivering the completed summary. The later report was accurate, but progression temporarily claimed completion ahead of its supporting artifact.

proposals.predicted_benefit: Makes closure follow the actual handoff and reduces unsupported completion markers without requiring repeated narration.
proposals.risks: An automatic post-completion prompt may still request another report. The reference-existing-summary clause limits duplication, although tool-level behavior may remain outside the template's control.
proposals.transfer_example: For a documentation-link maintenance task, report the changed pages, link checks and any unresolved destinations before checking handoff complete.
